command: set -eu; echo '===PATH==='; command -v go || true; command -v gofmt || true; echo '===COMMON==='; for p in /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt /opt/go/bin/go /opt/go/bin/gofmt /root/go/bin/go; do [ -x "$p" ] && echo "$p"; done; echo '===PODMAN==='; command -v podman || true; if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.ID}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'golang|go-tool|builder' || true; fi
